name: Freddy's
verdict: Freddy's is owned by investment funds affiliated with Rhône, a US-based private equity firm. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: acquired in September 2025 by investment funds affiliated with Rhône (global private equity, est. 1996, New York) from Thompson Street Capital Partners (Greenberg Traurig press release, 2025-09-08); no state in the chain → none. Checked conduct: in April 2024 the US Department of Labor found child-labor violations (149 children, $119,029 in penalties) at seven Freddy's locations operated by an Alabama franchisee — the finding is against the franchise operator, not Freddy's itself, so it is not a record for the sponsor under METHOD.md (noted for the record). RangeGoats GC official QSR partner for the 2026 season (LIV Golf announcement, early 2026).
